turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: I have a pain here, in my stomach. Since yesterday.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: To, na gode da faɗin haka. Ciwo yana kaifi, ko yana kama da dull ache?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Is it serious? What should I do?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Da alama ba mai tsanani ba ne, amma ina son duba. Sha ruwa, huta, and come back if the pain gets worse or you get a fever.
